Main holds stateLock over open/publish/sync and ResourceScope child cleanup, so proxy point/fault reads and live/events updates are serialized. Executor closes before Fixture teardown; configuration does not overlap workers. This is a source dependency, not runtime race-freedom proof.

reviewedFindings.reason: directory/file factories return a fresh map to each synchronous matrix. Explicit null values and missing/type/wrong-identity mutations are negative input. No executor/thread publication occurs in this Test; replacing with ConcurrentHashMap rejects null at fixture construction and erases the tested boundary.

finding.message: Use ReentrantLock rather than synchronization

reviewedFindings.reason: Test deliberately owns the public wrapper monitor while awaiting a separate worker operation with an explicit five/ten-second deadline. This proves production operations do not synchronize on a caller-visible object. Substituting a new ReentrantLock would no longer hold that monitor and remove the regression oracle. This does not exempt arbitrary synchronization elsewhere.
